gen-dafont-quantum-gf-cossette-texte: Quantum spaces its letters loose and generous, with open mouths and cropped ascenders, giving the heading a clean techy feel. Quantum is for display flair; Cossette Texte, with wide-eyed e's, does the reading.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-duru-sans: Cool, spaced-out tech lettering: Quantum keeps a steady weight word to word. Duru Sans backs it up with generous openings in its small letters and bodies that fill the line.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-fresca: Quantum goes loose and techy, its letters spaced generously, its mouths open and its ascenders kept short. Fresca is the better reader, with big bowls, no calligraphic thinning and connected counters.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans reads crisp and clean, its strokes holding steady from stem to curve and its e opened wide. Quantum's loose, spacious letterfit against that disciplined build is the real draw.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-gafata: Glass-tube lettering with a hollow, constant thickness: Quantum spreads loosely, its ascenders cropped short and its mouths open. Quantum draws the eye; Gafata, wide-eyed in its e, carries the text.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-geist: Quantum spaces its letters loosely and keeps its mouths open, with ascenders cropped short for a clean tech look. And Geist keeps a quiet, level beat, its words forming solid blocks rather than skylines.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-georama: Ring-shaped o's with a constant wall: Quantum is loose, open-mouthed and short in its ascenders, all cool tech. Georama keeps paragraphs gentle, with a wide c and barely rising capitals.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-gidole: Loose, open tech lettering in Quantum, then Gidole, a sans-serif drawn with neon-tube consistency and a high-set midline. Openness is the thread, from Quantum's mouths to Gidole's apart-held terminals.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-golos-text: Golos Text reads full and friendly, its x-height filling the line and its widely parted s keeping every word open. Under Quantum's loose, techy heading, pages of it would move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-hedvig-letters-san: Quantum joins its strokes without thinning them where they meet, set loosely with open mouths and short ascenders. And Hedvig Letters Sans reads warmly over pages, its small letters nearly capital height.
